observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
# uji: model :thinking vs biasa, jawaban panjang, ukur token reasoning sebenarnya
for m in ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
          "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored:thinking"]:
    b=json.dumps({"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Sebuah toko punya 47 apel. Dijual 18, lalu datang 25. Berapa sisa? Jelaskan langkahnya."}],"max_tokens":800}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    t0=time.time()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=180) as x: d=json.load(x)
    el=time.time()-t0; u=d['usage']; msg=d['choices'][0]['message']
    rl=len((msg.get('reasoning_content') or msg.get('reasoning') or ''))
    print(f"{m.split('/')[-1]:52}")
    print(f"   waktu={el:.2f}s compl_tokens={u['completion_tokens']} reasoning_chars={rl} cost=${u['cost']:.6f}")
    print(f"   jawaban: {(msg.get('content') or '')[:90]!r}")
PY
